findings.title: Validate required compact structure and source bindings before decoding qualified data
findings.evidence: Starting from an independently source-checked, bound 681 Work compact payload, decodeCompactGitWorkContext returns normally after each of: deleting continuityBinding; emptying its required effectInventorySources; replacing an inventory pointer with source index9999; deleting all normative rows; removing the active Plan2 row; changing the canonical Work source path to inputs/wrong.json; deleting nextAction while coverage remains authored; changing its source fragment to #/title; or selecting unavailable Task Plan999. Ordinary out-of-range answer/value indices do reject. The decoder never inspects continuityBinding and maps normative rows without enforcing Work cardinality, active/Task/Plan-to-Spec closure, exact field/address bindings or authored-next-action consistency.
findings.impact: The public decoder accepts structurally incomplete or contradictory data carrying source-qualified labels and emits usable decoded context. Required purpose/effect routes or authored recovery instructions can disappear without a hold. This violates the requested malformed/missing-pointer and lineage validation boundary; it is not a claim that pure decoding authenticates Git content or a native producer.
findings.requestedChange: Validate the full compact schema and cross-field invariants before returning: exactly one canonical Work, required referenced active/Task/Plan-to-Spec contracts, canonical normative field/source addresses, bound purpose/inventory pointer existence and indices, coverage/nextAction pairing and exact #/nextAction source. Use finite structural checks and reject malformed payloads without adding reads or authority. Add independent malformed-payload regressions covering these cases.

findings.title: Require the selected Task's referenced Spec and Plan in the compact closure
findings.evidence: For a real 681 raw context selected at HRR-A-CONTEXT-EFFECT, changing only its projected Task logical.planRevision from1 to999 leaves compactGitWorkContext source-qualified with holdReasons=[] even though no Plan999 is reached. The same constructor already checks existence for active Work refs and Plan-to-Spec refs through contractRef, but selected Task handling validates only logical shape and Task/Work/project IDs. The decoder also accepts this missing lineage.
findings.impact: The compact constructor can emit a qualified selected Task with unavailable lineage instead of holding the malformed input. Native owners using the canonical compact API cannot rely on the new lineage validation boundary for that case. No ability to forge native identity or source authority is inferred.
findings.requestedChange: Use the existing contract reference checks for both selected logical Spec and Plan and enforce appropriate selected Task scope/identity joins before qualifying. Preserve legitimate historical Task Plan1 while Work uses Plan2; do not force every Task onto the active revision. Add a missing selected Spec/Plan regression and retain the historical-positive test.
